d: Jesse saves an American tourist from calm waters, combined with a collective CPR effort from the lifeguards, the paramedics, and the Jewish Medical Response team.

A bluebottle attack turns the Bondi tower into a makeshift emergency ward. A tourist is stung mid-rescue. Lifeguards share a wave with blind surfer Derek Rabelo. Mouse handles the tower with a missing boy, a man with a dislocated shoulder, and a young woman overdosing on drugs.

500 Dutch tourists storm into the surf to celebrate New Year's Day. On the promenade Singlets treats a rollerblader with a severely dislocated knee. And American Superstar Comedian, Conan O'Brien, tries his hand at lifeguarding - with hilarious results.

In soaring temperatures, a 2-year-old girl is trapped in a locked car. A mother and daughter are saved by a man who can barely swim himself. Lifeguards catch a bag thief, who sends them on a chase. Harrison must improvise for equipment when he spots swimmers going under after pack-up time.

Lifeguards anticipate some well-deserved rest as Bondi's summer winds down, but a sudden monster swell brings unexpected challenges. Corey grapples with rescuing swimmers in massive waves. Trainees Ryan and Glick aim to impress in the upcoming lifeguard challenge.

New Years Eve brings massive crowds and huge surf. Reidy and Azza race to a man who's dislocated his shoulder in the water. A Swedish backpacker films himself getting seriously injured at Flat Rock. A local guy commandeers lifeguard equipment and races to save a man in serious trouble.

On the day of the lifeguard challenge, Max and Jesse chase an inflatable boat ride, leading to further trouble when Jesse gets a buoy rope stuck in the jetski intake. The lifeguards deal with tourists using cheap boogie boards whose arm leashes break, causing them to quickly sink in deep water.

Bondi reopens after its first closure since World War II. A paraglider crashes into the water, prompting a lifeguard rescue. Mario attempts to fix the lifeguard buggy. New lifeguard Max performs his first rescue. Bondi lifeguards bond and celebrate milestones in the tower.

Huge waves hit Bondi, leading Bisho to perform a cliff-face rescue with just flippers and a rescue tube. Trainee Taco faces consequences for rookie errors but earns redemption with the rescue of the season as a woman is caught beyond the waves in enormous surf.

Trainee lifeguard and Bra Boy member Jesse fractures his spine when dumped by a huge wave. Jake rescues a beginner surfer being smashed against cliffs. Matt Dee hopes to do at least one board rescue before the season ends. Lifeguards farewell summer in huge surf by riding hand built surf craft.

Chappo and H-man cautiously prepare a 19 year old German tourist for hospital after he's broken his back. Trainees Taco and Jesse have a difficult day in class struggling with the books, but get a chance to make the grade against the rest of the team in the annual lifeguard challenge.

A suspected body is seen floating in the water, prompting the launch of the jet ski. Ryan encounters trouble as he bogs the buggy. Jethro dislocates his shoulder on the jet ski and is taken to the hospital. Ryan redeems himself by rescuing a young man bouncing off the bottom of the ocean.

During big surf at Bondi, only the brave or foolhardy enter. Lifeguards aid surfers separated from their boards and chase a four-legged beach intruder. On Australia Day, Harrison faces his toughest rescue yet.

Singlets returns to work, performing his first rescue since the tragic drowning of a Norwegian man. Pierre from Hong Kong fulfills a dream by visiting the tower after saving all his money to meet the Bondi Rescue lifeguards. Hoppo imparts valuable lessons to kids on surviving in a rip.

Despite being an overweight kid without a surfing background, Reidy has overcome harsh criticism to become a lifeguard, setting his sights on a world record. Lifeguards must rescue a girl blown kilometres out to sea on a paddle board. A BMX rider has a fractured cheek and broken nose.
